description.value: Salt Spring Mercantile — 'The Merc' — is a licensed rural convenience store situated directly at the Fulford ferry terminal on Salt Spring Island, making it the natural first and last stop for cyclists crossing to or from the island. It stocks a broad range of groceries, alcohol, camping supplies, and gifts alongside a rotating lineup of goods from dozens of Salt Spring Island producers. An in-house bakery and a ready-made 'Meals to Go' program round out the offering for travellers looking to eat well on the road.

address.value: #101-2915 Fulford Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island, V8K 1X6
